linear_formula: C_r = {p in B_r: M_acc = 1, M_corn = 1, NDVI >= 0.65, LAI >= 2.50, LE/Rn >= 0.85, ETrF >= 0.85, H <= 50 W m^-2}
T_KC,r = median{T_s,p : p in C_r},  n(C_r) >= 30
dT_cold = H_cold r_ah,cold / (rho_cold c_p);  dT_hot = H_hot r_ah,hot / (rho_hot c_p)
a = (dT_hot - dT_cold)/(T_hot - T_KC,r);  b = dT_cold - a T_KC,r
dT_i = a T_s,i + b;  H_i = rho_i c_p dT_i / r_ah,i
L = -rho c_p u_*^3 T_a / (kappa g H_safe),  clipped to [-1000, 1000] m
LE_ref = lambda ETr_h / 3600;  ETrF_raw,i^KC = LE_i^KC / max(LE_ref, 1 W m^-2)
Delta ETrF_i^KC = ETrF_i^KC - ETrF_base,i;  Delta ETa_i^KC = ETa_i^KC - ETa_base,i

definition: Strict nested hierarchy from broad to narrow.
